messages.subject: How to display the "Pleas wait" spinning disk
parts:
Hi guys, 

Really like the new "Please Wait..." spinning disk now displayed while the R session get's initialized. I search for references but couldn't find anywhere where you share how you do this.

Is this something we could easily implements in all of our apps? Our end users are always baffled and try to interact with the app while the session is initializing...

thanks

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How to display the "Pleas wait" spinning disk
parts:
It really stinks but we don't have a simple implementation of this yet. We were going to make this a major feature of Shiny 0.10 but we weren't happy with how it looked by the time we were ready to finish up the release. Maybe for Shiny 0.11.

In the meantime you can install shiny-incubator and use the progressInit() and withProgress() functions.
